title: Blade of Heavenly Fate
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment the Tianji Record completely dimmed its light, a faint cold hum echoed from the depths of the heavens—that was an existence beyond comprehension, casting its gaze upon this mortal realm for the first time.

text.content: Golden light surged like a tide, pouring from the broken pages and flooding the entire secret chamber in an instant. Chen Ji felt an intense pain in his brow center, as if something dormant for ten thousand years was awakening. He instinctively tried to suppress it, only to discover the force was completely uncontrollable—it flowed backward along his meridians, rushing toward the forbidden seal deep within his Mental Sea that had never been touched before.

The fifth page. Not appearing passively, but actively tearing apart Mo Xiansheng's seal, forcibly unfolding before Chen Ji. The page held no text, only a phantom blade woven from countless threads of karma, its edge flowing with terrifying energy capable of rewriting heavenly laws. For the first time, Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled: 'Old one... has lived three thousand years, never witnessed such an异象.'

dialogue.content: The fifth page, the page of rules. It does not exist within the lineage of inheritance, nor within the original framework of the Tianji Record... Young master, what have you just refused?

text.content: Chen Ji offered no answer. His spiritual sense was drawn by that phantom blade, stepping into an unprecedented realm—he saw the chess game spanning three thousand years behind Cang Yutian, saw countless 'Cang Yutian'-like figures manipulated like chess pieces, and more importantly, saw that this very game was merely entertainment for some higher existence. Sweetness rose in his throat, blood trickling down the corner of his lips.

The fifth page's ability is not foresight, not rewriting, but 'creation'—personally inscribing one's own karma before the rules take shape. The cost is equally clear: each use will directly zero out Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value, rather than reducing it by five points. This means he has only one opportunity—use it and die. Mo Xiansheng's voice seemed to come from an extreme distance: 'Young master, this is the ultimate answer of the Tianji Record... and the ultimate curse.'

At this moment, Chen Ji's chest suddenly burned with heat. That was blood resonance—Chen Ji bloodline sealed for years had spontaneously broken through its shackles amid this earth-shaking upheaval. A weak yet resolute spiritual sense pierced through the void, directly crashing into his Mental Sea: 'Brother... Cang Yutian... is merely a gatekeeper... above... there are others...'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's voice came in fragmented bursts, each word seeming to cost her tremendous agony. 'The Holy Sect... used me... to seal a portion of that person's power... Brother, he is waiting for you... he has waited very long...'

text.content: Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, nails deeply embedding into his palms. The images transmitted through blood resonance gradually clarified: within a chaotic void, countless beings like Cang Yutian guarded some existence impossible to look upon directly, and that existence—the Eye of Heavenly Dao—observed with an almost playful attitude the moment Chen Ji disrupted the chess game. 'Understood.' Chen Ji said softly, his voice terrifyingly calm.

He suddenly laughed, the sound echoing through the silent chamber, carrying a hint of madness. 'Three thousand years of chess games, Cang Yutian is merely a gatekeeper. I, Chen Ji, have orchestrated the world, believing my calculations flawless, only to realize from the start I was capering on someone else's board.' Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: 'What does the young master intend to do?' Chen Ji raised his gaze, his eyes gleaming: 'Since the board is false, then let's overturn it.'

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's oppression pressed down like a physical force, and Chen Ji had to make a choice within an extremely short time—this step would determine his path ahead.

choices.description: Using the fifth page's ability to peer into the Eye of Heavenly Dao's true nature, finding its weakness before making deployments
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining crucial intelligence to lay foundations for subsequent schemes
choices.risk_hint: One-time ability, one mistake means total defeat

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his spiritual sense abruptly stabbing into that phantom blade. In an instant, endless streams of information flooded into his Mental Sea like a breached dam—he saw the Eye of Heavenly Dao's true form: not an eye, but a mass of pure will transcending good and evil, using all beings as chess pieces and karma as threads.

The cost took immediate effect: Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value plummeted from over fifty points to a single digit, and the Eye of Heavenly Dao simultaneously sensed the窥探. A terrifying aura far surpassing Cang Yutian locked onto him from the void. Mo Xiansheng shouted sharply: 'Young master, sever the blood connection quickly!'

choices.description: Actively exposing himself as bait, diverting the Eye of Heavenly Dao's attention away from Chen Nian
choices.visible_cost: Locked onto by the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian temporarily safe, buying time for rescue
choices.risk_hint: Directly enduring the gaze of an existence beyond comprehension

dialogue.content: From the blood pathway came Chen Nian's terrified voice: 'No! Brother, don't! You don't know how terrifying He is—'

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly severed the blood resonance, yet in the final moment released his own aura without any reservation. That aura was like a torch igniting in darkness, piercing directly through Cang Yutian's blockade to reach the depths of the heavens—the Eye of Heavenly Dao's attention had been completely drawn over.

choices.description: Temporarily收敛气息, using the Tianji Record's new abilities to scheme secretly, waiting for the opportune moment
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandoning the window for rescuing Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Preserving strength, establishing foundations for long-term confrontation

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the fifth page's ability back into the depths of his Mental Sea, while using the Tianji Record's fragments to shroud his own aura. Mo Xiansheng said approvingly: 'Good, preserving strength is the correct path. Though the Eye of Heavenly Dao is powerful, He is equally bound by the rules of this realm—young master merely needs sufficient time.'

From the blood pathway, Chen Nian's voice gradually grew faint: 'Brother... I will... wait for you...' Then fell into complete silence. Chen Ji closed his eyes, pressing that heart-wrenching pain into the deepest part of his heart. 'Wait for me.' He silently recited. 'This time, it's brother's turn to overturn this chess game.'

Regardless of which choice was made, the gears of fate had already begun to turn. Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the Tianji Record in his palm. The originally worn cover had inexplicably developed a crack—from the first page extending to the fourth, perfectly bypassing the fifth page's location, as if deliberately maintaining distance from it. Mo Xiansheng's voice was heavy: 'This is the Eye of Heavenly Dao's mark; He has already noticed you.'

Yet Chen Ji did not fly into a rage—he laughed instead. He reached out to stroke that crack, his fingertips transmitting waves of sharp pain. That was the warning of heavenly laws against him, and also Its frustration at being unable to act directly. 'So what if He sees?' He raised his head, his eyes reflecting the faint glow emanating from the Tianji Record. 'For three thousand years, countless prophets died on His board—did He ever personally intervene once? He dare not.'

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then sighed: 'The young master is wise. He indeed cannot directly interfere in the mortal realm, otherwise He would not need puppets like Cang Yutian. But this also means every step the young master takes from now on will be watched by Him.' Chen Ji nodded, his expression terrifyingly calm: 'Then let Him watch. I, Chen Ji, have never feared being observed—what I fear is having no one watch.'

The Tianji Record slowly closed, and that phantom blade faded away as well. However, in the instant before the pages fully shut, a faint glow escaped from the fifth page, transforming into a mark only Chen Ji could perceive, burning into the depths of his spiritual sense—that was the Eye of Heavenly Dao's first response to him, some gaze介于 threat and recognition.

The secret chamber returned to silence. Chen Ji slowly rose, his gaze casting toward the north—that was the direction of the Holy Sect, and also where Chen Nian was imprisoned. He did not immediately set out, but turned toward the corner, retrieving that 'Xuanwu Token' he had never used. Since the board is false, then create a new one with his own hands.

Beyond the Tianqing Sect, the sky suddenly changed. The originally clear night sky cracked open an invisible seam, and an eye pupil condensed from pure karma force opened from the depths of that seam, indifferently scanning across the entire continent. Cang Yutian perceived this phenomenon第一时间, his withered face showing the first traces of terrified color: 'He... actually intervened personally? What on earth did that废物 do?'

At the same time, the lingering influence of the Tianji Record's fifth page completely dissipated. Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling that brand new mark in his spiritual sense—it hung above his head like a sword, constantly reminding him: your enemy has never been any Cang Yutian. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a seriousness unprecedented: 'Young master, are you prepared? The road ahead will be more perilous than you can imagine.'

Chen Ji opened his eyes, a faint smile curling at his lips. He gazed toward the stone door of the secret chamber, as if he could penetrate the heavy rock and see that treacherous world beyond. 'Having seen the appearance of the Chess Player in this three-thousand-year game,' he said softly, 'there is no longer any reason to lose.' He stepped forward, and the stone door rumbled open. The new game officially began.
